newsitem.title: REPUBLIC OF IRELAND: Guardian PMPA to take on Ansvar's Irish business.
newsitem.headline: Guardian PMPA to take on Ansvar's Irish business.

text.p: Guardian PMPA Group, one of Ireland's largest motor insurers, said on Friday it is to take on the Irish policies of Ansvar Insurance when it withdraws from the Irish market in the near future.

"We are delighted to offer Ansvar's 7,500 policyholders renewal terms and continuity of cover when their present policies expire," Gerard Healy, chief executive of Guardian PMPA Group, said in a statement.
Ansvar, a Swedish-based group specialising in insurance for non-drinkers, was writing to its policyholders to inform them of its decision, the statement said.

Ansvar Managing Director, Geoffrey Williams, said that his company's specialist nature meant it was difficult to achieve the critical mass deemed to be necessary for success in what is becoming an over-crowded market.
Williams said that Ansvar policyholders would remain fully covered until their present policies fall due for renewal and that a full service would be maintained.
